title: Vistra agrees to buy Cogentrix's 5.5 GW gas fleet for ~$4.0B

sources.quote: IRVING, Texas, Jan. 5, 2026 — Vistra Corp. (NYSE: VST) today announced it has executed definitive agreements to acquire Cogentrix Energy, consisting of 10 modern natural gas generation facilities totaling approximately 5,500 MW of capacity.
The approximately $4.0 billion net purchase price implies a multiple of approximately 7.25x the 2027 expected Adjusted EBITDA contribution and approximately $730/kW for the portfolio.

explain: Vistra agreed to buy Cogentrix Energy, owned by funds of Quantum Capital Group, for a net purchase price of about $4.0 billion, adding 10 gas plants (about 5,500 MW) in PJM, New England and Texas to serve rising demand including data centers. Expected to close mid-to-late 2026. Plants named in the release: Patriot and Hamilton-Liberty (Pennsylvania), among 10 facilities.
